# Station Engineer
1. Your direct superior is the Chief Engineer.
2. Station Engineers must construct the AME and/or solar network before moving onto permanent station engines.
3. Station Engineers are to remain ready to respond to station damage, structural issues, and requests for renovation or repairs.
4. Station Engineers must check the Singularity, Tesla and power monitoring computer every 30 minutes or less.
5. At least one Station Engineer must remain in the department during non-emergencies to assist other crew members and respond to potential department emergencies.
6. Station Engineers are expected to monitor the condition of the station’s outer walls and windows to ensure that a hull breach event does not occur.
7. Any of the station’s spacefaring vessels must be repaired within 10 minutes of the time they are reported to be damaged.
